comparison: Same benchmark executable source, dependencies, parameters and seeds, run alternately. Baseline binary built from 16e90f4; current binary adds branchless bf16 widening in distance kernels, no per-query distance map, FxHash for the node map, and dirty-set extend instead of append.
scope: Synthetic uniform vectors; macOS arm64; machine not isolated (load average about 8-12 during the runs). Profile overrides kept debug line tables for sampling, so LTO was off. Report medians, not universal speedups. No RSS measurement. Recall@10 was identical in every phase.
